Title: Foster Care - Statistics
Question: Can the Minister state how many children were placed in foster care between January 2023 and December 2023, and provide a breakdown by age group?
Answer: During the period mentioned, a total of 84 children were placed in foster care. The breakdown is as follows: 0-4 years (30), 5-10 years (28), and 11-17 years (26).

Title: Road Maintenance - Victoria
Question: Can the Minister provide the scheduled dates for the resurfacing of Triq l-Imgħallem in Victoria, Gozo?
Answer: The resurfacing works for the mentioned road are scheduled to commence in the third week of May 2024, subject to favorable weather conditions and the completion of utility trenching.

Title: School Facilities - Science Labs
Question: Can the Minister list the secondary schools that received new laboratory equipment during the 2023-2024 scholastic year?
Answer: New equipment was distributed to the laboratories of the following Middle and Secondary Schools: St. Clare College, St. Nicholas College (Dingli), and St. Thomas More College (Zejtun).

Title: Industrial Parks - Occupancy
Question: Can the Minister state the current occupancy rate of the industrial units managed by INDIS in the Bulebel industrial estate?
Answer: As of the end of February 2024, the occupancy rate of industrial units in the Bulebel estate stands at 94.2%, with 112 out of 119 units currently leased.

Title: Geriatric Services - Bed Capacity
Question: Can the Minister provide information on the total number of beds currently available at the St. Vincent de Paul Long Term Care Facility?
Answer: The total capacity of St. Vincent de Paul Long Term Care Facility is currently 1,140 beds, following the recent renovation of two older wings.

Title: Building Authority - Personnel
Question: Can the Minister state the number of full-time enforcement officers currently employed by the Building and Construction Authority (BCA)?
Answer: There are currently 42 full-time enforcement officers employed by the Building and Construction Authority, with a recruitment process underway for an additional 10 officers.

Title: Firefighting - Equipment
Question: Can the Minister provide a list of new firefighting vehicles purchased for the Civil Protection Department in the last 24 months?
Answer: In the last 24 months, the Civil Protection Department has acquired four heavy-duty water tankers, two specialized industrial foam tenders, and three rapid intervention vehicles.

Title: EV Charging - Infrastructure
Question: Can the Minister provide the locations of the ten newest electric vehicle charging points installed in the Northern region of Malta?
Answer: The ten newest charging points in the Northern region were installed in Mellieħa (3), St. Paul's Bay (4), and Naxxar (3) at designated public parking areas.

Title: Afforestation - Gozo Projects
Question: Can the Minister state the number of indigenous trees planted in Gozo as part of the nationwide afforestation project during 2023?
Answer: In 2023, a total of 2,450 indigenous trees and shrubs were planted at various sites in Gozo, including the areas around Qortin and Nadur.

Title: Literacy Programs - Participation
Question: Can the Minister provide the number of students who participated in the 'Reading Ambassadors' program during the last academic year?
Answer: During the 2022-2023 academic year, approximately 4,500 students from various primary schools participated in sessions organized by the Reading Ambassadors.

Title: Public Service - Recruitment
Question: Can the Prime Minister state how many new recruits joined the Public Service through the People and Standards Division in the first quarter of 2024?
Answer: In the first quarter of 2024, a total of 312 new recruits joined the Public Service across various grades following competitive selection processes.

Title: Disability Benefits - Statistics
Question: Can the Minister state how many new applications for the Increased Severe Disability Assistance were approved between June and December 2023?
Answer: Between June and December 2023, the Department of Social Security approved 215 new applications for the Increased Severe Disability Assistance.

Title: EU Funds - SME Support
Question: Can the Minister provide the total amount of EU funds disbursed to local SMEs under the Business Enhance Grant Schemes in 2023?
Answer: In 2023, a total of €8.4 million was disbursed to local small and medium-sized enterprises through the various Business Enhance Grant Schemes.

Title: Maritime - Passenger Statistics
Question: Can the Minister state the total number of passengers who used the fast ferry service between Valletta and Mġarr, Gozo, in January 2024?
Answer: In January 2024, a total of 38,210 passengers utilized the fast ferry service between the Grand Harbour in Valletta and Mġarr, Gozo.

Title: POYC - Medicine Availability
Question: Can the Minister provide a list of medicines that were reported as out of stock under the Pharmacy of Your Choice (POYC) scheme as of April 15, 2024?
Answer: As of April 15, 2024, four items were reported as out of stock due to international supply chain issues. These include specific dosages of two cardiovascular medications and two respiratory treatments.

Title: Water Conservation - Reservoirs
Question: Can the Minister state the number of public reservoirs in Gozo that were cleaned and restored during the 2023 maintenance program?
Answer: During the 2023 maintenance program, the Ministry for Gozo oversaw the cleaning and structural restoration of 12 public reservoirs located in rural areas across the island.

Title: Police - Community Policing
Question: Can the Minister provide the number of localities in Malta and Gozo that are currently served by a dedicated Community Policing team?
Answer: As of the beginning of May 2024, the Community Policing initiative has been extended to cover 48 localities across Malta and Gozo.

Title: Infrastructure - Road Maintenance
Question: Can the Minister explain why, despite the significant budget allocated for rural road improvements in Gozo, several primary access routes remain in a state of dangerous disrepair, suggesting a failure in project prioritization?
Answer: The Ministry for Gozo allocates funds based on technical assessments of road safety and traffic volume. Several projects are currently in the procurement phase, and works will commence according to the established schedule, ensuring all funds are utilized transparently and effectively.

Title: Housing - Waiting Lists
Question: Will the Minister admit that the current social housing strategy is failing to keep pace with demand, given that the number of families on the waiting list has increased by 15% over the last year despite public claims of progress?
Answer: The government's housing policy is multifaceted, focusing not only on new builds but also on rent subsidies and rehabilitation of existing stock. Statistics are monitored closely, and current projects are expected to significantly reduce wait times upon completion.

Title: Construction - Enforcement Actions
Question: Can the Minister clarify why enforcement notices on unauthorized construction sites in the northern region have dropped significantly, leading to public concern that safety regulations are being overlooked to favor rapid development?
Answer: Enforcement actions are carried out by the Building and Construction Authority based on reported infringements and routine inspections. The frequency of notices fluctuates based on compliance levels, and there is no policy of leniency toward any developer.

Title: Education - Teacher Shortages
Question: Does the Minister agree that the persistent shortage of specialized science teachers in secondary schools is a direct result of the Ministry's failure to improve working conditions, despite repeated warnings from educators?
Answer: The Ministry is actively engaged in recruitment drives and offers various incentives for STEM educators. We remain committed to social dialogue with unions to ensure that the teaching profession remains attractive and well-supported.

Title: Health - Mental Health Facilities
Question: Can the Minister justify the delay in the promised refurbishment of the national psychiatric unit, an inaction that continues to compromise the dignity and care of vulnerable patients?
Answer: The refurbishment project for mental health facilities is a priority and is currently in the advanced design and planning stage. We are ensuring that the new facilities meet modern international standards for psychiatric care.

Title: Security - Community Policing
Question: Can the Minister explain why community policing remains understaffed in high-crime urban areas, suggesting that the program is more of a public relations exercise than a genuine security strategy?
Answer: Community policing has been successfully rolled out in various localities and continues to expand. Staffing levels are determined by the Commissioner of Police based on operational requirements and available resources.

Title: Transport - Public Bus Reliability
Question: Given the frequent reports of commuters being left stranded, will the Minister admit that the current public transport scheduling is inadequate for the needs of the working population?
Answer: The public transport operator is required to meet specific service levels. The Ministry monitors performance data and penalizes the operator for missed trips while constantly reviewing routes to improve efficiency.

Title: Gozo - Fast Ferry Service
Question: Can the Minister state why the fast ferry service between Gozo and Valletta remains inconsistent, and whether the government intends to subsidize the service further to prevent its total collapse?
Answer: The fast ferry service is operated by private entities under a commercial framework. The government remains committed to ensuring connectivity for Gozitans and is exploring all legal avenues to maintain a stable service.

Title: Environment - Waste Separation
Question: Does the Minister believe that the current waste separation targets are achievable, or is the lack of enforcement at the household level undermining the entire environmental strategy?
Answer: Waste separation is a collective responsibility. The government has introduced new regulations and educational campaigns to increase compliance, and enforcement measures are being scaled up gradually.

Title: Education - School Maintenance
Question: Will the Minister explain why several state schools are still waiting for basic repairs promised two years ago, while funds appear to be diverted toward high-profile promotional events?
Answer: Maintenance works in schools are prioritized based on urgency and safety. A substantial summer maintenance program is carried out annually, and all school budgets are managed to balance operational needs and long-term investment.

Title: Social Policy - Domestic Violence Units
Question: Can the Minister confirm if the domestic violence support units are currently operating at half-capacity due to a lack of specialized staff, effectively leaving victims without adequate protection?
Answer: The government has increased the budget for domestic violence services and is continuously recruiting social workers and professionals. Support services remain operational and are being strengthened through inter-ministerial cooperation.

Title: Governance - Public Sector Appointments
Question: Will the Prime Minister justify the recent surge in 'persons of trust' appointments within his office, and explain how this aligns with the promised meritocracy in the public service?
Answer: Appointments of persons of trust are made in accordance with established constitutional procedures and are intended to provide specialized support in policy implementation. The vast majority of the public service consists of career officials.

Title: Infrastructure - Road Safety Audits
Question: Can the Minister reveal the results of the road safety audits for the newly completed bypasses, or is the information being withheld because the designs prioritize speed over pedestrian safety?
Answer: Road safety audits are internal technical documents used to refine infrastructure designs. All new projects comply with international safety standards, including provisions for pedestrian crossings and cycle lanes where feasible.

Title: Justice - Court Delays
Question: Does the Minister accept that the increasing backlog of civil cases is a sign of a justice system in crisis, and what immediate steps are being taken to prevent a total standstill?
Answer: The government is investing heavily in the judiciary by appointing more judges and magistrates and digitizing court processes. These reforms are intended to increase the efficiency of the courts and reduce the duration of proceedings.

Title: Health - Emergency Room Wait Times
Question: Can the Minister explain why wait times at the emergency department have reached record highs this month, suggesting that the primary healthcare system is failing to redirect non-urgent cases?
Answer: The emergency department experiences seasonal fluctuations in demand. We are continuing to strengthen primary health centers and regional hubs to ensure that emergency services remain available for those in critical need.

Title: Governance - Public Consultation
Question: Will the Prime Minister admit that many public consultations on major projects are merely a 'box-ticking' exercise, as the feedback from local communities is consistently ignored in the final decisions?
Answer: Public consultation is a vital part of the democratic process. All submissions are reviewed by the relevant authorities, and while not every suggestion can be adopted, they frequently lead to significant modifications in project plans.

Title: Gozo Ferry - Maintenance Schedule
Question: Can the Minister provide a detailed schedule of the planned maintenance for the Gozo Channel fleet for the year 2024?
Answer: I am tabling the requested maintenance schedule for the current year, outlining the periods during which each vessel will be undergoing scheduled dry-docking.

Title: Social Housing - List of Contractors
Question: Will the Minister table a list of all private contractors currently engaged in the construction of social housing projects in the Northern region?
Answer: The information requested regarding the contractors engaged for the projects in the Northern region is being compiled and will be laid on the Table of the House in a future sitting.

Title: Road Projects - Completion Dates
Question: Can the Minister provide a list of all ongoing arterial road projects and their respective projected completion dates?
Answer: I am laying on the Table of the House a list of current projects managed by Infrastructure Malta along with their estimated timeframes for completion.

Title: School Repairs - Expenditure Breakdown
Question: Will the Minister publish a breakdown of the expenditure related to emergency repairs carried out in state primary schools during the 2023-2024 academic year?
Answer: The breakdown of expenditure for emergency repairs in state primary schools is being tabled today, categorized by school and nature of work.

Title: Industrial Estates - Lease Agreements
Question: Can the Minister table a list of all new lease agreements signed for industrial units in the Marsa Industrial Estate since January 2023?
Answer: I am tabling a list containing the requested information regarding new leases in the Marsa Industrial Estate, excluding commercially sensitive details.

Title: Community Clinics - Equipment List
Question: Will the Minister provide a list of the medical equipment purchased for the new community clinic in Swieqi?
Answer: I am laying on the Table of the House the list of medical equipment procured for the Swieqi community clinic to ensure high-quality primary care services.

Title: Police Fleet - Procurement Contract
Question: Can the Minister confirm if a contract has been signed for the procurement of new electric patrol vehicles for the Malta Police Force and table said contract?
Answer: A contract has been signed following a public tender process. A copy of the contract, with redacted personal data for security reasons, is being tabled.

Title: Gozo Hospital - Staffing Levels
Question: Will the Minister provide a breakdown of the current nursing staff levels at the Gozo General Hospital by department?
Answer: I am tabling the information regarding the distribution of nursing staff at the Gozo General Hospital as of the end of last month.

Title: NGO Grants - List of Recipients
Question: Can the Minister table a list of all NGOs that received government grants for social inclusion projects in 2023?
Answer: The list of recipient NGOs and the respective amounts granted in 2023 for social inclusion projects is being laid on the Table of the House.

Title: Waste Management - Tendering Process
Question: Will the Minister provide a timeframe for the conclusion of the tender for the new waste-to-energy facility?
Answer: The evaluation process for the waste-to-energy facility tender is currently in its final stages, and an award is expected by the end of the third quarter of this year.

Title: Laptop Distribution - Statistics
Question: Can the Minister provide a breakdown of the number of laptops distributed to students in Year 7 during the last school term?
Answer: I am tabling the statistics requested, broken down by college and individual state school, for the distribution cycle completed in December.

Title: Public Service - Consultancy Contracts
Question: Will the Prime Minister table a list of all consultancy contracts awarded by the Office of the Prime Minister since January 2024?
Answer: I am laying on the Table of the House a list of consultancy contracts issued by my Office during the period requested, including the names of the consultants and the value of each contract.

Title: Elderly Homes - Inspection Reports
Question: Can the Minister table the latest inspection reports for private elderly homes that receive government subsidies?
Answer: The Social Care Standards Authority regularly conducts inspections. Summaries of the findings and compliance scores for the subsidised homes are being tabled for the information of the House.

Title: Maritime Infrastructure - Project Timeline
Question: Will the Minister provide a detailed timeframe for the completion of the breakwater repairs in Marsaxlokk?
Answer: The works are scheduled to be completed in three phases. The final phase is expected to be finished by mid-2025. I am tabling the full project timeline.

Title: Building Regulations - Enforcement List
Question: Can the Minister provide a list of all enforcement notices issued by the Building and Construction Authority in the first quarter of 2024?
Answer: I am tabling a list of enforcement notices issued during the requested period, categorized by the type of infringement and the locality.

Title: Urban Greening - Financial Breakdown
Question: Will the Minister publish a breakdown of the costs associated with the urban greening project in Romeo Romano Gardens?
Answer: The financial breakdown for the Romeo Romano Gardens project, including landscaping and civil works, is being laid on the Table of the House.

Title: Sports Facilities - Maintenance List
Question: Can the Minister table a list of all public sports facilities currently undergoing maintenance or renovation?
Answer: I am tabling a list of facilities managed by SportMalta that are currently under renovation, along with the expected dates for their reopening to the public.

Question: Social Housing - Refurbishment Totals - Can the Minister state how many social housing units were fully refurbished and returned to the housing pool during the 2023 calendar year?
Answer: The Ministry for Social Policy and Children's Rights can confirm that a total of 412 social housing units underwent significant refurbishment and were subsequently re-allocated to tenants during the course of 2023.

Question: Gozo Fast Ferry - Scheduled Trips - Will the Minister provide information on whether the frequency of the fast ferry service between Valletta and Mġarr will be increased for the upcoming summer season?
Answer: The Ministry for Gozo and Planning confirms that the fast ferry schedule will be augmented by four additional daily round trips starting from the first week of June to accommodate increased seasonal demand.

Question: Education - School Transport Subsidies - Can the Minister specify the total expenditure allocated for the free school transport scheme for the 2023/2024 scholastic year?
Answer: The Ministry for Education, Sport, Youth, Research and Innovation states that the total expenditure for the free school transport scheme for the current 2023/2024 scholastic year stands at €28.5 million.

Question: Economy - SME Digitalization Grants - How many small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) successfully received grants under the Digitalization Scheme during the first quarter of 2024?
Answer: The Ministry for the Economy, European Funds and Lands reports that 87 small and medium-sized enterprises were approved for and received funding under the Digitalization Scheme between January and March 2024.

Question: Social Services - Domestic Violence Support - Can the Minister state the number of new social workers recruited specifically to handle domestic violence cases since January 2024?
Answer: The Ministry for Social Policy and Children's Rights confirms that 12 additional social workers have been recruited and assigned to the domestic violence support unit since the beginning of this year.

Question: Environment - Urban Green Spaces - Are there specific plans and an allocated budget for the development of a new public park in the Birkirkara area within the next fiscal year?
Answer: The Ministry for the Environment, Energy and Regeneration of the Grand Harbour confirms that a 5,000sqm site in Birkirkara has been identified for a new green space, with a budget of €2.1 million allocated for 2025.

Question: Employment - Third-Country National Work Permits - Can the Minister provide the total number of work permit renewals processed for third-country nationals during February 2024?
Answer: The Ministry for Home Affairs, Security, Reforms and Equality confirms that Identity Malta processed and approved 3,420 work permit renewals for third-country nationals during the month of February 2024.

Question: Pensions - Disability Allowance - What is the exact weekly increase in the disability pension that has been implemented for the 2024 budget cycle?
Answer: The Ministry for Social Policy and Children's Rights states that the weekly disability pension has been increased by exactly €15.00 per week as per the measures announced in the 2024 Budget.

Question: Infrastructure - Gozo Road Works - Will the Minister provide the projected completion date for the major reconstruction works currently being undertaken on the main road leading to Mġarr, Gozo?
Answer: The Ministry for Transport, Infrastructure and Public Works confirms that the reconstruction of the Mġarr road is on schedule and is expected to be fully completed by October 2024.

Question: MCAST - Green Energy Courses - How many new diploma courses related specifically to renewable energy and green technology were introduced at MCAST for the current academic year?
Answer: The Ministry for Education, Sport, Youth, Research and Innovation confirms that five new diploma-level courses specializing in solar technology and wind energy systems were introduced at MCAST this academic year.

Question: Consumer Affairs - Price Monitoring - Can the Minister state how many price monitoring inspections were carried out in retail supermarkets by the MCCAA during March 2024?
Answer: The Ministry for the Economy, European Funds and Lands confirms that the Malta Competition and Consumer Affairs Authority (MCCAA) conducted 215 separate price monitoring inspections across various supermarkets in March 2024.

Question: Elderly Care - St. Vincent de Paul Staffing - How many new residential beds were added to the St. Vincent de Paul Long-Term Care Facility following the recent wing expansion?
Answer: The Ministry for Health and Active Ageing confirms that the recent expansion of the St. Vincent de Paul facility resulted in the addition of 60 new beds, all of which are now fully operational.

Question: Coastal Management - Sliema Promenade - Has a budget been allocated for the emergency repair of the coastal sea wall along the Sliema promenade following recent storm damage?
Answer: The Ministry for Transport, Infrastructure and Public Works confirms that a dedicated budget of €1.2 million has been allocated for the structural repair of the Sliema sea wall, with works set to commence next month.

Question: Maritime Safety - Officer Recruitment - Can the Minister state the number of new maritime safety officers recruited by Transport Malta since the start of the current year?
Answer: The Ministry for Transport, Infrastructure and Public Works confirms that eight new maritime safety officers have been recruited and have completed their training since January 2024.

Question: Home Affairs - Community Policing - Is the new community policing hub in the Marsa locality fully operational, and what are its current operating hours?
Answer: The Ministry for Home Affairs, Security, Reforms and Equality confirms that the Marsa community policing hub became fully operational on February 14, and it is currently manned daily from 08:00 to 20:00.

Question: Water Services - Desalination Plants - What is the current daily output in cubic meters of the Hondoq ir-Rummien water desalination plant in Gozo?
Answer: The Ministry for Environment, Energy and Regeneration of the Grand Harbour confirms that the Hondoq ir-Rummien reverse osmosis plant is currently producing an average of 9,000 cubic meters of potable water per day.

Question: Sports Facilities - Marsa Athletic Track - Can the Minister confirm if the resurfacing of the Marsa athletic track is scheduled to take place during the 2024 summer recess?
Answer: The Ministry for Education, Sport, Youth, Research and Innovation confirms that the resurfacing works for the Marsa athletic track are scheduled to begin in July 2024 and are expected to last eight weeks.

Question: Social Housing - Waiting List Statistics: Can the Minister state the exact number of applicants currently waiting for social housing in the Northern region?
Answer: The Housing Authority is currently undergoing a comprehensive review of all pending applications to ensure that the list reflects the most current socio-economic data of the applicants.

Question: Education - School Extension Costs: Will the Minister provide a detailed breakdown of the total expenditure incurred for the new extension of the primary school in Qormi?
Answer: The project is still in its final stages of completion, and the final accounts will be tabulated once all contractual obligations and certification of works are finalized.

Question: Environment - Park Completion Date: Can the Minister provide a specific date for when the new rehabilitation project at the national park will be open to the public?
Answer: Works are progressing steadily through various phases, and the site will be inaugurated as soon as all safety inspections and landscaping requirements are met.

Question: Health - New Screening Program: When will the new national screening program for cardiovascular health be officially launched for citizens over the age of 50?
Answer: Technical preparations and the procurement of the necessary medical equipment are well advanced, and the launch will be announced following the completion of the staff training phase.

Question: Infrastructure - Roadwork Budget: Can the Minister provide the specific budget allocated for the resurfacing of rural roads in the Mellieħa area for the current fiscal year?
Answer: Infrastructure Malta is implementing a multi-year plan for rural road upgrades, with funds being allocated based on the priority of works identified by technical surveys.

Question: Economy - Business Grant Recipients: Will the Minister publish the list of companies that received the green transition grant during the last call for applications?
Answer: Information regarding financial assistance to private enterprises is processed in accordance with established transparency guidelines and will be published in the government gazette as required by law.

Question: Justice - Court Case Backlog: Can the Minister state the number of pending civil cases in the Family Court that have been waiting for a sentence for more than three years?
Answer: Ongoing judicial reforms and the recent investment in digital court systems are specifically aimed at increasing the efficiency of the judiciary and reducing the duration of all legal proceedings.

Question: Prime Minister - Consultant Contracts: Can the Prime Minister provide a list of all consultants currently engaged by his office and their respective remuneration packages?
Answer: The Office of the Prime Minister engages professional services in various specialized fields to ensure the effective implementation of the government's electoral mandate.

Question: Social Policy - Rehabilitation Program Outcomes: Can the Minister provide the success rate of the new youth rehabilitation program introduced two years ago?
Answer: The program is currently being evaluated by an independent board to assess its long-term social impact, and a report will be tabled once the study is concluded.

Question: Health - Surgical Waiting Times: Can the Minister state the average waiting time for orthopaedic surgeries at Mater Dei Hospital as of December 2023?
Answer: The hospital management is continuously optimizing the use of operating theatres and expanding outpatient services to ensure that patients receive treatment in the shortest time possible.

Question: Environment - Waste Management Data: How many tonnes of plastic waste were successfully recycled through the national collection scheme in the last six months?
Answer: Waste collection data is currently being verified and reconciled by the relevant agencies and will be included in the upcoming environmental performance report.

Question: Transport - Maritime Route Launch: When will the new scheduled ferry service between Valletta and Marsaxlokk commence operations?
Answer: Discussions with potential operators and stakeholders are ongoing to ensure that the service meets the required standards of safety and sustainability for commuters.

Question: Gozo - Cultural Festival Funding: Can the Minister provide a breakdown of the €200,000 spent on the recent regional cultural festival in Victoria?
Answer: Expenditure on cultural events is managed to maximize the visibility of Gozitan heritage, and all financial records are subject to standard public sector auditing procedures.
